title: Subtitle Tools - Online tools to fix your subtitles
meta_description: Free online tools to convert, sync, clean, and fix subtitle files. Supports all major formats including SRT, SSA, VTT, SUP, and SUB/IDX.
h2: Converters | Syncing | Fixing and cleaning | Other tools

title: Convert Subtitles to Srt: online format converter
meta_description: This tool converts subtitles to srt. It supports most subtitle formats including ass to srt, ssa to srt, webvtt to srt, and smi to srt.

title: Convert Subtitles to Vtt: online format converter
meta_description: This tool converts subtitles to WebVtt. It supports most subtitle formats including srt to vtt, ass to vtt, sub to vtt, and smi to srt.

title: Convert PGS subtitles (.sup) to srt
meta_description: This tool converts pgs subtitles to srt. These subtitles have a sup file extension and they usually come from Blu-ray, HD DVD or normal DVD discs.

title: Convert Sub/Idx Subtitles to Srt: online format converter
meta_description: This tool converts sub/idx subtitle files to srt. It uses OCR to convert the subtitles. It supports subtitles from Blu-ray, HD DVD and DVD discs.

title: Convert Subtitles to Plain Text
meta_description: This tool extracts all text from subtitle files and saves it in a plain txt file. It can create movie transcripts and can be useful for language learning.

title: Convert subtitles and text files to PDF
meta_description: This tool converts subtitles and text files to PDF. It can combine multiple files into a single PDF and works with both subtitle files and plain text files.
h2: Converting subtitles to PDF | Converting plain text files to PDF

title: Sync Subtitles: fix out of sync subtitles
meta_description: This tool can change the timing of subtitle files. It fixes out of sync subtitles by shifting the subtitle timing forwards or backwards.

title: Partial Subtitle Resync: fix out of sync subtitles
meta_description: This tool fixes out of sync subtitles. It resyncs specific sections of a subtitle file, useful when parts of your subtitles are out of sync.
h2: How to sync subtitles with this tool

title: Srt cleaner: remove unwanted formatting from subtitles
meta_description: This tool removes brackets ({}, (), [], <>), HTML tags, lyrics, watermarks, and SDH from srt files. It also fixes subtitles that are completely uppercase.

title: Convert files to UTF-8: fix broken text encoding
meta_description: This tool converts text files to unicode UTF-8. It fixes gibberish text, question marks, and mojibake. Supports all text and subtitle files.
h2: Fixing text encoding | VLC showing weird symbols or boxes

title: Subtitle Merger: combine two subtitles into a single file
meta_description: This tool merges two subtitle files into a single subtitle file. It can create multi-language subtitles or merge the subtitles for CD1 and CD2.

title: Extract Subtitles from Videos and Movies — Free Online Tool
meta_description: This tool extracts and downloads embedded subtitles from video files, directly in your browser. Supports all video types including MKV, MP4 and AVI.

title: Timed Lyrics Editor — Edit, Sync & Preview Song Lyrics
meta_description: Upload a song, automatically download lyrics, and sync them line by line. Preview, edit, and download synced .lrc lyric files all in your browser.
h2: Help | Create Synchronized Lyrics (.LRC) Files Online

title: Subtitle Color Changer: color the text of your subtitles
meta_description: This tool changes the color of your subtitles. Colored text makes subtitles stand out and easier to read. Beware that not all video players support colored text.
h2: Changing the color of text | Subtitle color support

title: Subtitle Position Changer
meta_description: This tool makes subtitle text appear in specific locations on screen. It can for example make your subtitles appear at the top of the screen.
h2: Change the position of subtitle text | Not working?

title: Chinese Pinyin Subtitle Generator
meta_description: This tool turns Chinese subtitles into pinyin subtitles. Learn Chinese from movies and reading pinyin. Supports srt, ass and ssa files
h2: About pinyin subtitles | VLC not displaying Chinese srt subtitles correctly | Convert modes
